description:
The work on site is done, but you still have to explain when and where each photo was taken?

Team photos scattered across phones and group chats while the supervisor chases and sorts them?

Timeprint records capture time and GPS location, organizes team photos by project, and shares them by web link—no app required.

【1. One photo explains the job】

Add capture time, address, GPS, project, work notes, and a company logo directly to photos and videos. A supervisor, client, or inspector can understand the job without calling the person who took the photo.

Capture time cannot be edited manually in Timeprint. When server time is available, Timeprint uses it to calibrate the timestamp. GPS coordinates come from the device location and cannot be entered manually. The address is shown from the location result, making the site record more reliable.

Whether you are recording progress, an inspection, a repair, or a handoff, the photo carries the job context.

【2. Your crew takes photos. Timeprint organizes them.】

Choose a team and project and turn on auto-sync. New Timeprint photos can sync automatically to Team Space, organized by project, with each member's photos easy to find.

The office can see what each project captured and who took each photo. No chasing photos in group chats. No downloading, renaming, and filing everything by hand.

【3. Send one link. No app required.】

Create a web link for the whole team, one project, or one member. Supervisors, clients, inspectors, and partners can view shared team photos in a browser without installing Timeprint.

Managers can use the Timeprint team web portal on a computer to manage photos, projects, and members. For reports and delivery, export personal work photos as PDF, ZIP, or KMZ and team photos as PDF or ZIP.

【4. Built for these jobs】

• Construction: daily progress, work before it is covered, site issues, and inspections

• Fiber optic and telecom: excavation, cable routes, splicing, equipment locations, and installation

• HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and repairs: fault locations, before-and-after work, and completion

• Property management: move-in and move-out checks, inspections, repairs, and maintenance

• Cleaning: arrival, before-and-after work, completion, and quality checks

• Security: patrol time, location, site conditions, and incidents

• Warehousing, logistics, and delivery: loading, cargo condition, damage, handoffs, and drop-offs

• Landscaping and roofing: maintenance, progress, weather, and site issues

• Retail and field teams: store visits, displays, client sites, and attendance

• Contractors and small businesses: branded job records organized by project

Questions or suggestions? Email: support@timeprint.net

See every detail hidden inside your photos — including whether they were made by AI. Exif Detail is a photo info viewer that shows the full metadata of any picture - camera model, lens, exposure settings, GPS location, date taken, resolution, file size, and AI generation disclosure - then lets you remove what you don't want to share.

Take control of your digital footprint. Before sharing photos online, remove hidden GPS location, timestamps, and device data that could expose where you live, work, or travel. Exif Detail shows you what's hidden in your images, then strips it in one tap.

One-tap metadata removal

Strip sensitive information including GPS coordinates, capture dates, camera models, and editing software from your photos. Create clean copies safe for social media while your originals remain untouched.

Privacy Score

See exactly how much your photo metadata exposes about you. Each photo receives a privacy score showing which data points could reveal your location, device information, or personal details.

AI image detection

Find out if a photo is AI-generated before you trust it or share it. Exif Detail checks for AI disclosure metadata. It doesn't analyze the picture itself just if AI markers are present in the image. Most tools and popular social media apps strip the AI markers from an AI generated photo, so that shows as unknown for those flags and not verified as real.

Photo information at a glance

• File name, file size, and image resolution

• Image dimensions, width, height, and orientation

• Date taken, date modified, and time zone

• Camera make, model, and lens

• File format and color space

• Heic metadata

• AI-generated photo detection

View 40+ metadata tags

Analyze embedded data from PNG, JPG, RAW, DNG, HEIC, WEBP and GIF files including camera settings, GPS coordinates, timestamps, device information, AI generation markers, and lens details.

GPS location viewer

If location data exists in your photo, view the exact capture location on Google Maps. Useful for organizing travel photography or verifying where images were taken.

Photo histograms

Analyze exposure levels, color distribution, and tonal balance in your images. View color and grayscale histograms to understand your photos better.

Export and save metadata

Save metadata in CSV, XML, or JSON formats for documentation or workflow integration. Create custom tag favorites for quick access to frequently needed information.

Who uses Exif Detail?

Privacy-conscious users who want control over what their photos reveal before sharing online.

Photographers who analyze camera settings to improve their technique.

Travelers who organize photo collections using location data.

Professionals who need to verify image metadata for documentation or authenticity.

Anyone who wants to check if a photo is AI-generated before trusting or re-sharing it

Privacy by design

All photos are processed locally on your device. Your original images are never modified. You control exactly which metadata is removed or preserved.

Permissions explained

Camera: Capture new photos inside the app

Location: Display GPS metadata on maps when it exists in your images

Storage: Load and save photos from your device

Network: Required for map display, sharing features, ads, and crash reporting

Note: No personal data or photos are uploaded to external servers. All processing happens on your device.

Support

Questions or feedback? Contact sdremthix@gmail.com or use in-app support.

Take control of your photo metadata. Download Exif Detail today.

description:
Real or AI-generated? Expose AI is an AI image detector that tells you in seconds — a clear verdict, a confidence score and the evidence behind it. Check any photo, screenshot or link, entirely on your phone.

That dating profile, marketplace listing, news photo or viral post: check it before you trust it. No upload, no account — the image never leaves your device.

NEW IN THIS VERSION

• Deep Scan: two stronger AI models study 12 views of the image — less than half as many “Uncertain” verdicts as a Standard scan*

• Region map: see where the AI signal is, and catch AI edits or pasted areas in real photos

• Videos & GIFs: checked frame by frame, with one verdict for the whole clip

• Find the source: look an image up on Google Lens, Bing or TinEye to see where it first appeared

• Check a link: paste a post, page or image link — X (Twitter), Reddit, news sites, blogs — and pick the image to check

• Paste from the clipboard, or share images, videos and links to Expose AI from any app

• “Spot the AI” guide: 10 tells to check yourself, from hands and text to light and shadows

• PDF reports (Pro): save or send a record of any verdict, with the file’s SHA-256 fingerprint

• Now in English, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français and 日本語

HOW IT WORKS

• Metadata check: reads Content Credentials (C2PA), XMP and AI-generator tags — an image that declares Firefly, FLUX, Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Gemini or another generator is flagged on the spot

• On-device AI models, trained on the visual fingerprints of AI image generators, handle everything else: screenshots, stripped metadata, re-saved files

• Standard scan: one fast model, unlimited

• Deep Scan: two models × six views each, plus a nine-region scan

• A clear call — Likely AI-generated, Likely real or Uncertain — and a “How we decided” card that shows which signal made it

CHECK IMAGES FROM ANYWHERE

• Choose from your gallery, paste, or share from Chrome, Google Photos and social apps

• Check a whole profile or listing at once with Batch (Pro, up to 12 images)

• Crop a screenshot down to just the picture

• Keep a private history of every verdict, and share a verdict card in one tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Every scan runs on your device. No account, no sign-up, no upload — detection even works offline. Links are opened directly from your phone, like a browser would. Your history stays on your phone, and you can pause or clear it any time.

FREE AND PRO

• Free: unlimited Standard scans and 3 Deep Scans to start — plus one more for each short ad you choose to watch. Ad-supported.

• Expose AI Pro: unlimited Deep Scans and region maps, Deep Scan on every video frame, Batch check, PDF reports and no ads — weekly or yearly, or a one-time lifetime unlock. Prices are shown in the app before you confirm; cancel anytime in Google Play.

A NOTE ON ACCURACY

AI-image detection is probabilistic — a signal, not proof. Results vary with editing, compression, screenshots and brand-new generators, and metadata can be stripped or faked. Videos are judged by their frames, so the newest AI video generators can slip through. When the signal is weak, Expose AI says “Uncertain” instead of guessing. Use it as one tool among several, never as the final word about a picture or a person.

*Measured on 12,627 test images: about 10% Uncertain with a Deep Scan vs 28% with a Standard scan.

An AI photo checker, a fake image detector, an AI art detector, an image authenticity scanner — whatever you call it, if you have ever looked at a picture and wondered “is this AI?”, Expose AI answers on the spot, privately, on your phone.

description:
Infrared Camera turns your photos into striking images with an infrared, thermal and night vision camera look. Take a photo or pick one from your gallery, tap a color palette – and your picture looks like it was shot with a thermal camera.

IMPORTANT – HONESTLY EXPLAINED

Regular smartphone cameras cannot capture heat or true infrared images. This app is an infrared filter for photos: it converts the brightness of your photo into false colors (bright = "hot", dark = "cold"). It does not measure temperature and it is not a replacement for a real thermal camera or night vision device. For fun, creative photos and social media, it is exactly right.

FEATURES

• Infrared filter with 8 color palettes: IRON, MAGMA, THERMAL HUNTER, NIGHT (night vision look), RADIO, COLD, SPECTRAL and WHITE HOT

• White hot / black hot switch, just like professional thermal cameras

• Sliders for intensity, heat map contrast, gain (brightness) and reality mix (blend with the original photo)

• Take a photo with the camera or choose one from your gallery

• Save to your gallery or share instantly

HOW IT WORKS

1. Open the camera or pick a photo

2. Choose an infrared palette

3. Fine-tune with the sliders

4. Save or share

TIP

Many smartphone cameras can see the light of a TV remote control. Press a button, hold the remote in front of the camera and take a photo – the glow of the infrared LED stands out even more with the filter. Whether this works depends on your phone's camera sensor.

FREE & PRO

The app is free and supported by ads. Exported images carry a small watermark that you can remove by watching a short video. With Infrared PRO (monthly, yearly or one-time purchase) all images are ad-free and watermark-free.

PRIVACY

Your photos are processed only on your device and are not uploaded to our servers.

Turn your Android phone into a professional-grade DSLR camera. Vidca gives you full manual control over every shot — ISO, shutter speed, white balance, and focus — wrapped in a clean, one-handed interface built for real photographers.

Whether you're shooting a fast-moving subject, a long-exposure night scene, or a perfectly balanced portrait, Vidca puts pro controls at your fingertips.

MANUAL CAMERA CONTROLS

• ISO — pick from standard stops or enter a custom value

• Shutter speed — fast to long exposure, snap to standard values or go custom

• White balance — presets for any lighting, or lock to a precise Kelvin temperature

• Manual focus — continuous, single auto, or full manual focus distance

• Exposure compensation (EV) for fine-tuned metering

• Live ISO and shutter readout so you always know your exposure

• AE/AF lock — long-press to lock exposure and focus on your subject

• Fine-tune optical stabilization, lens distortion correction, and noise reduction

• Metering mode — matrix, center-weighted, or spot

PROFESSIONAL PHOTO

• RAW (DNG) capture for maximum editing latitude

• Ultra HDR for brighter highlights and richer detail

• Camera Extensions — Night, HDR, Bokeh, and Face Retouch on supported devices

• Quality priority: maximize quality, balanced, or fast shutter

• Flash control: auto, on, or off

• Self-timer for hands-free shots

• Burst & intervalometer — capture multiple frames automatically

• Exposure bracketing (AEB) for tricky, high-contrast lighting

• Volume button shutter

• Focus bracketing for focus stacking, plus adjustable JPEG quality

PROFESSIONAL VIDEO

• Record in up to 4K (UHD), Full HD, and HD

• HDR (10-bit) video on supported devices

• Slow motion at 120/240fps on supported devices

• Choose your frame rate (24–60 fps) where supported

• Standard or preview-optimized video stabilization

• Optional audio recording

• Video bitrate, mic mode, and a live audio level meter

PORTRAIT MODE

• Beautiful background blur (bokeh) with an adjustable blur amount

• Keep your subject sharp while the background melts away

COMPOSITION TOOLS

• Grid and level overlays to help you keep shots straight

• Live histogram to judge your exposure at a glance

• Quick torch toggle

• Front-camera selfie guide — a framing overlay to help you center your face

• Waveform monitor, zebra stripes, and focus peaking for precise exposure and focus

LIBRARY & REVIEW

• Library — every photo and video, grouped by day, with instant last-shot review (video playback + pinch-zoom) and multi-select delete

SMART TOOLS

• AI-powered suggestions that read the scene and recommend better settings

• Precision zoom with quick zoom presets (.5x, 1x, 2x, 5x)

• Lens picker — switch between ultra-wide, wide, and telephoto where available

• Tap to focus and pinch to zoom

• Optional geotagging writes GPS location into your photo's EXIF data

• Shooting templates — pick a scene for live AI setting suggestions

• Bluetooth remote shutter

DESIGNED FOR ONE-HANDED USE

A redesigned, DSLR-inspired interface keeps the controls you need within thumb's reach, so you can stay focused on the shot.

Every photo and video you capture is saved straight to your device gallery in full quality.

Vidca is built for hobbyists, content creators, and pros who want more than the stock camera — without a complicated learning curve.

Download Vidca and start shooting like a pro.

description:
RETRO 80'S — TURN ANY PHOTO INTO A 1980s PHOTOGRAPH

Big hair. Neon. Grain. Flash. Retro 80's takes one photo from your camera roll and hands it back like it was shot in 1986 — a yearbook portrait, a prom night snapshot, a Miami sunset, a neon-lit nightclub. No filters to stack, no presets to tweak, no editing skills. Pick a look, tap Generate, and watch a whole decade land on your face in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick a style from the catalog.

2. Add your photo — from your gallery or straight from the camera.

3. Tap Generate. Your retro portrait is ready in seconds.

That's it. No sliders, no layers, no learning curve.

20 HAND-BUILT 80s LOOKS

• Yearbook '86 — fluffy hair & lasers

• Neon Prom — taffeta & flash

• Acid Wash Crew — denim & windbreakers

• Synthwave '84 — cyber & grid

• Aerobic Club — spandex & neon

• Crimped Wave — big hair & lip gloss

• Miami Vice — pastel & palm trees

• Glam Metal — hairspray & leather

• Old School Hip-Hop — tracksuit & boombox

• Mall Glamour Shot — soft focus & feathers

• VHS Tape — scan lines & static

• Polaroid Party — instant film & flash

• Roller Rink — disco ball & skates

• Arcade Kid — joysticks & neon carpet

• New Wave — asymmetric & pastel

• Pop Star '85 — lace gloves & bows

• Breakdance — cardboard & beats

• Neon Noir — rain & replicant

• Family Portrait — matching sweaters & blue fog

• Action Hero — sweat & explosions

NOT JUST SELFIES

Every style is framed for whoever is actually in the picture — Portrait, Couple, Pet or Group. Send your partner to prom in 1987, put the whole family in matching sweaters in front of a blue fog backdrop, or give the dog its own mall glamour shot. Filter the catalog by category and find the look that fits the photo you already have.

YOU CONTROL THE OUTPUT

• Aspect ratio: Auto, 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9 — ready for stories, feeds or wallpapers.

• Resolution: 1K, 2K or 4K. Post it, print it, or set it as your lock screen.

WHY IT LOOKS LIKE 1986

Each style is written by hand, not scraped from a filter pack — wardrobe, hair, backdrop, lighting and film stock are all part of the recipe. Acid Wash Crew comes back yellowed and creased like a print pulled out of a family album. VHS Tape gets its scan lines and static. Yearbook '86 gets the blue-to-purple laser backdrop and the soft studio flash. And through all of it, your face still looks like your face.

TRENDING NOW

A curated Trending row on the home screen keeps the strongest looks of the moment up front, so you always know what everyone is making this week.

YOUR OWN LIBRARY

Every photo you create lands in your personal library, newest first. Come back any time to save it to your phone's gallery, send it out through the share sheet — Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, anywhere — or delete it for good. Nothing gets lost between sessions.

PRO & CREDITS

Retro 80's runs on credits. A Pro subscription refills your balance on every renewal — 3,000 credits weekly or 30,000 yearly — and you can top up any time with a one-off credit pack (1,200 / 3,000 / 6,000 credits). Bigger output costs more: 1K, 2K and 4K each have their own price, and you always see your balance before you commit. Credits are only spent when a picture actually lands — if a generation fails, you keep them.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Google Play → Subscriptions. Already subscribed on another device? Settings → Restore Purchases.

BUILT FOR SPEED

The heavy lifting happens in the cloud, so an old phone works as well as a new one. Android 8.0 and up.

PRIVACY

Your photos stay yours. An upload is used for one thing only: making the picture you asked for. Delete anything from your library whenever you like.

SUPPORT

Questions, ideas, something broken? Settings → Contact us. We read every message.

Grab a photo. Pick a decade. Press Generate.

description:
GPS Map Camera puts the street address, the GPS coordinates, the date, the time and a mini map of the spot you are standing on straight onto the photo.

The stamp is merged into the picture before it is saved, so it survives sharing, compression and re-upload. Drag it anywhere on the frame before you shoot.

WHAT GOES ON THE SHOT

- Street address, city, state, ZIP code and country, looked up from your position

- Latitude and longitude to six decimal places

- Date and time, running live in the viewfinder

- A mini map centered on where you are standing

- Your own note, typed straight onto the frame

8 STAMP TEMPLATES

Basic - address, date, time, coordinates

Advance - all of it, plus the mini map

Small - a compact strip that stays out of the shot

Round - a rounded card with the map inset

Bear, Soccer, Flower and Travel - decorative frames, included with Premium

8 MAP STYLES

Streets, Outdoors, Light, Dark, Satellite, Satellite Streets, Standard and Standard Satellite. Pick whichever map reads best against the photo you just took.

VIDEO GETS THE STAMP TOO

Record video and the stamp is written into the finished MP4 with the sound, so the location travels with the footage wherever you send it. Front and back camera both work.

YOUR OWN TEXT ON THE PICTURE

Add a note to any shot: nine fonts, bold, italic, underline and strikethrough, uppercase, your choice of text color and background color, and left, center or right alignment. Drag it, pinch it, rotate it, mirror it.

YOUR PHOTOS ON A MAP

Everything you capture is plotted on an interactive map and grouped by area. Tap a group to open every photo and video you shot there. A visual log that builds itself, with no folders to keep.

SAVED LOCATIONS

Drop a pin, name it, give it a radius from 10 m to 1000 m, and the app tells you when you are inside it. Useful for the places you keep going back to: delivery zones, depots, sites on a round.

CAMERA CONTROLS

Photo, video and quick modes. Full, 1:1, 9:16 and 3:4 ratios. Flash on, off or auto. A 3 or 5 second timer. A 3x3 or 4x4 grid. Pinch to zoom, tap to focus, shutter sound on or off, and a level indicator so the horizon sits straight.

SHARING

Send stamped photos and video out through the Android share sheet to messaging, email or a cloud drive. Pick several at once.

A DAILY REMINDER

Set a time and the app nudges you once a day to shoot the day's log. Turn it off whenever you want.

WHO CARRIES IT

Delivery drivers proving the drop. Insurance and property inspectors. Surveyors and site engineers. Maintenance and service rounds. Anyone who has to say where a photo was taken and be believed. Hikers, cyclists and travelers who want the place on the picture instead of buried in a file.

PREMIUM

- Premium stamp templates

- Save photos without watching an ad

- Every map style on your stamp

- No ads anywhere

Sold as a weekly or a yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The price and the billing period are shown before you buy.

GPS Map Camera is a GPS camera, a map camera, a geotag camera and a timestamp camera in one app, for anyone who needs the place and the time printed on the picture rather than buried in a file.

GOOD TO KNOW

The address lookup and the mini map need a network connection; without one the app falls back to your last known coordinates and the map area stays blank. Location permission is required for the stamp to work at all. Camera and microphone permissions are used for capture only.

The stamp is drawn onto the picture. The app does not write GPS tags into the file's own EXIF data.

A camera that prints the date and time onto the photo itself.

The stamp is burned into the picture at the moment you press the shutter, so it stays with the file wherever you send it. No editing step afterwards, no account, no upload.

■ Eight date and time formats

2026/08/06 14:23 / 2026-08-06 14:23:45 / 06/08/2026 14:23 / 08/06/2026 02:23 PM / Aug 6, 2026 2:23 AM / time only / date only. Pick the one your country or your paperwork uses.

Choose one of nine positions, then drag the stamp on the camera screen to fine-tune it. Your placement is kept for the next shot.

■ Readable on any background

Seven colors, three sizes and three typefaces. Add an outline around the letters, a frame around the stamp, or a background panel behind it - whatever it takes to stay legible against a bright wall or a dark floor.

■ Add one more line

Put a site name, a case number or a short note under the date.

■ Straight into your gallery

Photos go to your normal photo gallery, ready to share by mail or chat. Front and back cameras both work.

Good for

・Work records, site photos and progress reports

・Proof of delivery, repairs and inspections

・Attendance and time keeping

・Diet, training and plant growth logs

・Everyday photos you want dated

description:
Put a real date stamp on your photos — the amber imprint an old film camera burned into the negative, or a clean modern caption. Pick a stamp once and every photo after that is a single tap.

The stamp is drawn the way a camera drew it: as light added to the picture, so it glows over shadow and softens against a bright sky, instead of looking like text pasted on top.

THE STAMP GALLERY

• 56 built-in stamps, on six shelves: Film, Digital, Social, Print, Record and Creative

• Film — the amber quartz date back, the single-use camera's big bright imprint, dot matrix, the red data back, faded, left-corner and date-plus-time variants

• Digital — early digicam yellow, camcorder and tape overlays, security and dash-cam timestamps, the Y2K look

• Social — story pill, highlight bar, condensed caps, subtitle, weekday caption, neon

• Print — lab print, handwriting, instant-film caption, felt-tip note, wedding serif

• Record — receipt, ISO 8601, evidence red, job-site plate, time bar

• Creative — neon sign, gold serif, sticker, terminal green, blueprint

• Star the ones you use and pin one as your default

• Save your own settings as named templates and reuse them

MAKE IT YOURS

• Order — day/month/year, month/day/year or year/month/day

• Separator of your choice, and padding: 08, a blank cell, or just 8

• Two- or four-digit year, with or without the apostrophe ('92)

• Month as digits, as AUG, or abbreviated in your own language — and the weekday if you want it

• Time on or off, with seconds, 12- or 24-hour, on one line or stacked above the date

• Colour, size, opacity, glow, bold, italic, tilt and letter spacing

• Backing plate — none, a translucent pill, or a highlight bar

• Position — any of the four corners, top or bottom centre, or the middle, with fine nudging

• 12 built-in typefaces, including true seven- and fourteen-segment LED faces, dot matrix, typewriter, serif, marker and script — all bundled in the app, so a stamp looks the same offline and on the very first run

A WHOLE ROLL AT ONCE

• Batch stamping: pick your photos, choose the stamp and the corner, export them all

• Each photo gets its OWN date, read from its own capture data — a holiday roll comes out with the day each photo was really taken, not today's date

• If a photo carries no capture date, the app tells you instead of quietly stamping today

• Up to 6 photos at a time; watch one ad to stamp up to 50

• The capture date is kept on the exported copy. Location is never written.

ALSO A FULL PHOTO EDITOR

• Light and colour — brightness, contrast, exposure, highlights, shadows, warmth, curves, levels, HSL, black and white, HDR, clarity

• Filters with adjustable strength, plus grain, vignette, blur and sharpen

• Crop, straighten, rotate, mirror, perspective and decorative borders

• Text, stickers and emoji, freehand drawing, colour splash, selective edit

• Built-in camera, a before/after comparison slider, and export as JPG, PNG or WebP

HONEST BY DESIGN

Free, with no watermark on anything you export. No account, no cloud, no subscription — your photos never leave your phone and the app works fully offline. It is paid for by occasional ads, and ads never block your editing.

PRODUCTION FIELDS

Edit production info on the slate and in project details: scene, shot, take, roll, day, director, DOP, operator, lens, mic, FPS, location, day/night, sound, MOS/sync, and INT/EXT. Industry-style lettered shot codes (A, B, … Z, AA) with quick increment/decrement controls keep you moving between setups.

CLAPPERBOARD

LOGGING & EXPORT

Every clap logs scene, shot, take, roll, day, and timecode to your shot history. Add notes and a rating, then filter the log by scene or shot — no more wading through footage. ■ App name change

"MyGallery" has been renamed "MM Gallery".

The new name comes from the developer, "mfactory", and the former name, "My Gallery".

You can continue using your photos, videos and settings as before. The name on your home screen remains "Gallery".

────────────────────

When you just want to look at your photos and videos, a simple gallery app is enough. I didn't want to be locked into cloud storage — and if I did use one, I wanted to choose it myself. That's why I built MM Gallery.

MM Gallery keeps that simplicity while organizing the photos and videos on your phone by folder, and lets you quickly edit them before you share — all in an ad-free gallery app.

■ Organize photos and videos by folder

See the folders on your phone — Camera, Screenshots, Downloads, and more — listed just as they are.

Switch between the "Folders" tab and the "All" tab, whichever view suits you: browsing folder by folder, or seeing everything at once.

Choose grid or list view for your folder list. In list view, thumbnails line up side by side, so you can check what's inside a folder — and open a photo — without opening the folder first.

Supports sort order, grouping, pinning, favorites, and hiding folders, so you can find what you need while keeping your usual folder structure.

■ Quick edits before you share

Crop, rotate, perspective correction, mosaic, blur, add text, add arrows and shapes, brush drawing, and beauty retouch.

Add notes to a screenshot, hide something you'd rather not show, or just make a photo clearer.

For documents or whiteboards shot at an angle, just mark the four corners and straighten them out as if shot head-on.

■ Revisit where you took your photos, on a map

Photos and videos with location data appear as pins on a map. Look back on trips and everyday moments, grouped by where they were taken.

Filter by date range, and tap a marker to open all the photos taken near that spot. Dark mode supported.

■ Use a NAS or your own cloud storage as extra photo space

Connect to a shared folder (SMB / Samba) on a NAS or a Windows PC, and browse the photos and videos on your local network right inside the app — the same way you browse the ones on your phone. Copy and move files between your phone and the share, too.

Photos and videos stored in Google Cloud Storage (GCS) or S3-compatible storage work the same way. Set a destination per folder — handy for backups too.

Key features

• Browse and organize photos and videos on your phone by folder

• Switch the folder list layout (grid / list)

• Sort, group, pin, mark favorites, and hide folders

• Create albums, organize photos and videos, and change their order

• View media full-screen, pinch to zoom during video playback, and play Motion Photos

• Map view for geotagged photos (filter by shooting period, show current location)

• Slideshows (playback and saving as videos)

• Photo and video editing (crop, rotate, filters, blur, mosaic, text, arrows, shapes, drawing with a variety of pens, perspective correction, skin retouching, and face effects)

• Copy, move, and delete photos and videos, and restore them from the trash

• Browse photos and videos on NAS / Windows shares (SMB / Samba), FTP, Google Cloud Storage, and S3-compatible storage

• Set up cloud sync and backup per folder, with controls for Wi-Fi and mobile data use

• No ads

Recommended for anyone who wants their photos and videos tidily organized by folder, quick edits before sharing, a map view of where their photos were taken, or a way to reach the photos on their NAS from their phone.

description:
A passport photo you can submit — unedited, and measured against the real rule first. Passport Photo Maker frames, measures and checks your passport photo, visa photo or ID photo entirely on your phone, then tells you in plain language what passes and what doesn't.

WE CHECK YOUR PHOTO. WE DON'T EDIT IT.

No AI, no filters, no beautifying, no slimmed jaw. Passport and visa rules require an unaltered, true likeness, so we never touch your pixels. Most passport photo apps do the opposite: they cut you out and paste you onto a generated background — exactly the alteration that gets a photo sent back.

A LIVE COACH GETS THE SHOT RIGHT

Point the camera and a live biometric guide lines up your eyes, head size and framing as you shoot. When it fits the official spec, the button turns green.

THE RIGHT PASSPORT PHOTO SIZE, WHEREVER YOU'RE GOING

Passport photo size is not one number. A US passport photo and US visa photo are 2x2 inches — 51x51 mm, square. Most of Europe, India, the UK and Australia use 35x45 mm. Brazil and Canada want 50x70. Pick the country and the passport size photo comes out right the first time, at the correct print size and DPI.

CHECKED AGAINST THE REAL SPEC

Your passport photo is measured against the actual country requirement: print size, head height, eye line, background and expression, graded on 7 named checks. If something is off you see exactly what to fix.

NO SUBSCRIPTION. NOTHING HIDDEN.

No weekly plan, no trial that quietly converts, no surprise renewal. You see the finished photo before you pay. Then pay once for a clean file, or watch a short video for 24 hours of free exports.

44 COUNTRIES, WITH RECEIPTS

Passport photo, visa photo, ID photo and more. Each spec shows its official source and the date we last verified it, so you can check our numbers instead of trusting them. Where a government contradicts itself, publishes a size range or won't take a printed photo, the spec says so.

THE ONES EVERYONE ELSE GETS WRONG

Spain isn't 35x45 - it's 26x32. France forbids a white background. South Africa wants light grey or cream, Kuwait blue, Qatar grey. And half the apps out there make you remove your glasses in countries that allow them - Russia actually requires you to keep them on.

EVERY PASSPORT PHOTO SIZE, NAMED

Argentina 40x40 - Australia 35x45 - Brazil 50x70 - Canada 50x70 - Chile 40x50 - China 33x48 - Egypt 51x51 - France 35x45 - Germany 35x45 - Ghana 35x45 - Hong Kong 40x50 - India 35x45 - Indonesia 40x60 - Ireland 35x45 - Israel 35x45 - Italy 35x45 - Japan 35x45 - Kenya 51x64 - Kuwait 40x50 - Malaysia 35x50 - Mexico 35x45 - Morocco 35x45 - Nepal 35x45 - Netherlands 35x45 - New Zealand 39x52 - Pakistan 35x45 - Poland 35x45 - Qatar 35x48 - Russia 35x45 - Saudi Arabia 40x60 - Schengen Area 35x45 - Singapore 35x45 - South Africa 35x45 - South Korea 35x45 - Spain 26x32 - Sri Lanka 35x45 - Switzerland 35x45 - Taiwan 35x45 - Türkiye 50x60 - UAE 35x45 - Ukraine 100x150 - United Kingdom 35x45 - United States 51x51 - Vietnam 40x60.

NO PHOTO BOOTH, NO STUDIO

No booth, no appointment, no print shop. Take your passport photo at home and leave with a file that is the right size first time — passport, visa, national ID, driving licence or student card.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE

Face detection, cropping and the compliance check all run on-device with Android ML Kit. We don't upload your photo, don't ask for an email and have no account — there is no server for your face to sit on. We get anonymous crash and usage stats, and the optional video uses an advertising ID. Never your photo, face or name.

SAVE, SHARE OR PRINT

Export the finished passport photo at the right size and DPI. Save it, send it to a print service, or print a ready-to-cut 4x6 sheet at a photo kiosk.

Passport photo, visa photo, ID photo, green card and OCI. Get the passport photo size right first time, without handing your face to anyone.

description:
SolCalc is a sun and moon calculator that tells you when the light will be right — at any place on Earth, on any day you pick.

Get sunrise, sunset and solar noon together with data of the blue hour, the golden hour and the twilight times (civil, nautical and astronomical). Calculate moonrise, moonset and moon phases (calculated data are approximations of +/- 1 day accuracy). You can also calculate and visualize the shadow length that an object will create.

Point your camera at the scene and AR mode draws the sun's path straight onto the live view, with golden hour and blue hour markers, azimuth, elevation and shadow length.

A widget puts the next golden hour, sunset or blue hour on your home screen, and reminders tell you before the light changes — calculated on your phone, without an account or a server.

In this app you can view data for multiple locations. These can be defined manually or automatically by getting your GPS location. Additionally you have the opportunity to manually set timezones of the locations, which can be helpful if you are planning trips to locations with another timezone than the one where you currently are.

Core features at a glance

• Calculation of sunrise, sunset and solar noon

• Calculation of moonrise and moonset + moon phase

• Calculation of the civil blue hour

• Calculation of twilight times (civil, nautical and astronomical)

• Calculation of the golden hour

• Visualization of the azimuth data of sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset

• Visualization of the azimuth data of sun and moon for a specific time

• Calculation and visualization of an object's shadow (e.g. helpful for planning photovoltaics/PV alignment)

• Visualization of the sun's height over a day

• AR mode: follow the sun's path live through your camera

• Home screen widget with the next golden hour, sunset, blue hour or sunrise

• Golden hour reminders for any place – daily, on chosen weekdays or once, e.g. "Golden hour begins in 30 min"

• Definition of multiple locations, including your current position (based on GPS)

• Forecast

Wear OS app with tile and complications

⌚ Day ring: a 24-hour dial shows night, twilight, golden hour and daylight around the clock, with the next sunrise, sunset or blue hour and a live countdown in the middle.

📋 Today's times at a glance – sunrise, solar noon, golden hour, sunset and blue hour, plus the twilight phases you choose in the phone app – and the moon phase with moonrise, moonset and their direction.

📍 Locations sync from your phone, or use the watch's own GPS. Always-on display supported.

🧩 Tile: swipe from your watch face to the SolCalc tile for today's sunrise, sunset and day length at your selected location.

⏱️ Complications: put SolCalc data right on your watch face – the next sunrise or sunset, a daylight gauge showing how much of the day is left, the next golden or blue hour with a live countdown, and the moon phase with the next moonrise or moonset.

Pro features

• No limit in selecting a date for calculation (max. +/- 7 days in the free version)

• Full monthly forecast

• Unlimited AR mode

• Reminders for sunrise, sunset, blue hour, solar noon, moonrise, moonset and the full moon, with the direction the full moon rises in

• Day ring widget: all of today's sun times around the clock, plus the moon

• Export of forecast data to Excel tables

Note: the calculated values are approximations to plan your photography trips. Additionally it depends on the weather situation how good, or whether, the blue or golden hour is visible.

description:
Everyone wants to take great photos, yet many photos look "flat." That flatness usually comes down to one thing: the light. Photography is the art of using light, and landscape photography is the art of using natural light. That's why landscape photographers chase the light — the moment when the Sun, the Moon, or the Milky Way and stars hit the best angle or the ideal position. Our other app, PlanIt Pro / PlanIt Earth, gives you a powerful tool for pre-planning these moments. But on location everything changes — you're racing the light, with no time to fiddle with your phone. That's why we created PlanIt Live: the best experience for photographers in the field.

PlanIt Live isn't only for professionals. Anyone with a camera — even a phone camera — can benefit, and so can anyone who simply wants to witness a beautiful scene under ideal light. We designed Live around a single use case: you need a piece of information, you take out your phone, open PlanIt Live, get the answer at a glance, and put the phone away — the whole thing takes just a few seconds. In most cases you don't even need to tap anything. And with reminders, you often don't need to take the phone out at all: set alerts for the ephemeris events that match your style, and the app will let you know when the moment arrives.

So what does PlanIt Live offer?

CAMERA CONTROL

Shutter Release: tether Sony, Nikon, or Canon bodies over USB and shoot from the app — live view with tap to focus, shutter/aperture/ISO wheels, video recording, interval shooting for timelapses, and several cameras at once (Bluetooth: shutter only).

SUN, MOON AND MILKY WAY

Daytime photography: sunrise/sunset, blue hour, golden hour, and moonrise/moonset times and directions.

Night photography: dark-night start/end times, the Milky Way Center's position and timing in the sky, planets, star trails, and the Bortle dark-sky scale.

Real Milky Way: rendered as an actual photographic image across the sky dome, precisely placed for your location and time, with an optional H-alpha view emphasizing the nebula regions.

3D Compass: directions to the Sun, the Moon, and the Milky Way Center at any time of day.

SKY EVENTS AND SPACE WEATHER

Calendar & Events: open it from the menu or by tapping the date in the header — Events, Moon, Night, and Aurora views, each with per-day indicators and day details.

Space weather & aurora: free cards for Live Sun, solar flares, solar wind, short- and long-term Kp forecasts, storm probabilities, and Aurora Tonight.

description:
SensePose is an AI camera app for Android, built around a real-time AI Pro Mode.

Point your phone at a scene and the AI reads the light, then sets ISO, exposure, shutter speed and white balance live, the way a photographer would. It corrects continuously as the light changes instead of jumping between presets. Each shot is then captured as a RAW HDR+ multi-frame burst and merged on your device, using the same multi-frame method Google Pixel and iPhone cameras rely on, on hardware that shipped without it.

SensePose is a camera app. It is not a posing or pose-coaching app.

AN AI CAMERA, NOT A FILTER APP

A real AI camera does the photographer's job while you shoot. Most alternatives do not: GCam ports lock you to auto and often wash out color on non-Pixel phones, and manual camera apps such as ProShot and Open Camera give you sliders but no AI. SensePose sets the exposure for you, frame by frame, and you can override any value by hand.

RAW HDR+ BURST MERGE, ON DEVICE

Every photo is a burst of RAW frames merged on your phone. Multi-frame merging recovers highlight detail, reduces noise in the shadows and keeps color true to the scene, instead of relying on a single over-processed JPEG.

BETTER RESULTS IN DIFFICULT LIGHT

Backlit windows, dim restaurants and streets at dusk are where budget phone cameras usually struggle with noise, blown highlights and flat color. Merging several RAW frames gives the camera more light and more data to work with, so these shots often come out cleaner than with the stock camera.

SCENE RECOGNITION

The scene classifier recognises more than 360 environment types, from beaches and forests to restaurant interiors and city streets, and suggests presets suited to where you are.

CINEMATIC TONE GRADING

Photos are finished with a cinematic tone grade, so they look deliberate rather than flat, without opening a separate editor.

BACKGROUND REMOVAL AND AI EDITING

Remove backgrounds and make AI edits inside the app. Useful for product photos, profile pictures and quick corrections.

FREE TO USE

The camera is free: real-time Pro Mode, RAW HDR+ burst merge, scene presets and full-resolution export. Free exports carry a small watermark. SensePose Pro removes it, including on photos you have already taken.

ALSO INCLUDED

• Burst mode and HDR capture

• Background processing, so the shutter stays responsive

• Pro Mode and burst merge run on your device, with no photo upload required

• Android 10 and later, about 28 MB

WHO IT IS FOR

Owners of budget and mid-range Android phones, including Redmi, Poco, Infinix, Tecno, itel, Galaxy A, Moto G, Realme and OnePlus Nord. On these phones the camera hardware is often better than the software driving it. SensePose is built to close that gap, with AI that works during the shot rather than a filter applied afterwards.

Made by Profazia.

Why Ente Photos?

You own your originals (no compression, no quality loss), you control who sees them (end-to-end encrypted sharing), and you can leave whenever you want (easy export, no lock-in). Powerful on-device AI finds faces and moments without sending your photos to a server. Open-source code means our promises are verifiable, not just marketing.

Features:

ONLY YOU HOLD THE KEY: Your photos and videos are encrypted on your device before they ever leave it. Automatic encrypted backup means your memories reach the cloud already secured — not even we can see them. Zero-knowledge architecture means your encrypted photo and video storage is 100% private — nobody can see them without your permission, guaranteed.

SHARE ON YOUR TERMS: Share end-to-end encrypted albums with family or friends from your gallery, and invite them to add their own photos and videos. You decide who sees what, and you can revoke access anytime.

YOUR MEMORIES, YOUR WAY: Ente curates private stories from your photo library and surfaces memories from previous years — visible only to you, shared only when you choose.

FIND ANYTHING, ON YOUR DEVICE: On-device AI photo search recognises faces, objects, and places across your entire library using natural language search. Your photos never leave your phone to make this work. Works with all formats, including HEIC and live photos — every file, exactly as captured.

YOUR STORAGE, THEIR PRIVACY: Invite up to 5 family members to any paid plan at no extra cost. Everyone shares the cloud storage — nobody shares the photos. Each person gets their own private, encrypted gallery.

YOUR PHOTOS, ON EVERY DEVICE: Access your private photo storage on iOS, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, and the web.

THREE COPIES, ZERO COMPROMISES: Ente stores your encrypted cloud backup in 3 secure locations — including an underground facility. Automatic photo and video backup that survives anything.

MOVE IN — OR OUT — FREELY: Import your photo library from Google Photos or other providers using our desktop app. And if you ever want to leave, export everything at full original quality. No lock-in, ever.

EVERY PIXEL, EXACTLY AS YOU SHOT IT: All photos and videos are backed up in original quality — no compression, no resizing, no stripped metadata.

YOUR APP, YOUR LOCK: Set a PIN or use biometrics to ensure no one else can access your photo library.

A VAULT FOR WHAT'S MOST PRIVATE: Move sensitive photos and videos to a hidden folder that is password protected by default — invisible to everyone but you.

COLLECT WITHOUT LIMITS: Share a link and let anyone upload directly to your album — no Ente account needed.

ALWAYS IN SYNC WITH YOUR PARTNER: Automatically share your camera roll with a partner so they see your photos the moment you take them. Private sharing, end-to-end encrypted.

VERIFY EVERYTHING YOURSELF: Ente Photos is fully open-source and has been independently audited by third-party security experts. You don't have to trust our word — you can read the code.

LOCKED DOWN, YOUR WAY: Two-factor authentication, app lock, hidden vault — layer your private cloud storage security exactly as much as you want.

SELF-HOST OR LET US: Power users can run their own Ente server. Everyone else gets fully managed encrypted cloud storage — same privacy, zero maintenance.

HUMAN SUPPORT: Reach us at support@ente.io and a human being will respond. Not a bot, not a template — just a regular member of our team!

description:
You took the photo on site but missed the watermark.

Or it already has one, but the time or address needs a correction.

TimeEdit helps you complete or correct time, location, and GPS details on existing photos, making real on-site records clearer and easier to organize.

1. Complete a Photo You Already Took

Field work moves quickly. You take a photo and move on, then notice later that the watermark is missing, the timestamp is slightly off, the location pin landed nearby, or an existing stamp needs an update.

There is no need to retake a useful photo because one detail was missing. Add a watermark to an existing photo or update the time and place on a photo that already has one.

2. Update the Watermark and EXIF Together

Choose a photo, then set the date, time, address, and GPS information it should display. If it already has a watermark, clean up the old stamp and replace it with updated details.

The change is not visual only. When you save, the watermark and the photo's EXIF capture time, GPS latitude, GPS longitude, and location data change together. Previous values are rewritten using the details you set.

Core capabilities:

• Add or adjust time, address, GPS, map, and weather

• Replace an existing watermark with updated details

• Choose from more than 100 watermark designs

• Mark details with text, arrows, boxes, brushes, and magnifiers

You can also take new watermarked photos directly in TimeEdit.

3. Keep an Unwatermarked Copy in Cloud Album

When Cloud Album is enabled, an unwatermarked copy of the original TimeEdit camera capture is synced to the cloud separately from the finished watermarked photo.

Need a different time, address, or watermark later? Download the unwatermarked photo during its retention period and create another version.

The cloud copy helps reduce the risk of losing a photo if your phone is damaged, replaced, or accidentally cleared. After confirming the upload, you may remove the local copy to reduce device storage use.

Cloud photos are retained for 60 days. You can download or delete them during that period. Deleted photos remain in the Recycle Bin for 24 hours before permanent removal. Automatic sync can be turned off in Settings.

4. Made for Real On-Site Records

Useful for construction progress, property inspections, equipment maintenance, cleaning, deliveries, store visits, project handovers, travel, and other real-world situations.

Add a missed watermark, correct an address, update an existing stamp, or download an unwatermarked cloud copy and prepare it again.

The photo is already there. Complete the record.

5. Frequently Asked Questions

Q1. Can I edit a photo that already has a watermark?

Yes. Clean up the old watermark, add a new one, and set its time, address, and GPS location. Only edit photos you own or have permission to modify.

Q2. Does editing also change the information stored inside the photo?

Yes. The visible watermark and the photo's EXIF capture time, GPS coordinates, and location information change together. Previous values are replaced with the details you set. Keep a backup if you need the earlier information.

Q3. What if the detected address is inaccurate?

Search for a place, choose a position on the map, or edit the address. Once confirmed, the watermark and the GPS and location information stored in the photo are updated together.

Q4. What does Cloud Album store, and can I delete it?

It stores an unwatermarked copy of photos captured with TimeEdit. During the retention period, you can download it, add another watermark, or delete it.

The work already happened. Do not let a missing watermark or small information error make a useful photo harder to use.

Open TimeEdit and make the record clear, complete, and ready to use.

description:
Filmode Vibe is a retro toy film camera in your pocket — the vintage, analog, disposable-camera aesthetic, live. Shoot photos and clips with the look baked in — live film LUTs, rain on the lens, VHS static — then pin every shot to a cork board you can share as one picture.

LIVE FILM LOOKS

Six hand-crafted looks — Golden, Teal, Analog, Glow, Midnight and Mono — rendered live on the viewfinder with a real 64³ film LUT on the GPU. What you see is exactly what you get.

REAL-TIME EFFECTS

Ten effects, live and baked into your photos and videos at capture time: Rain with refracting drops and trails, Halation glow, VHS, Frost, film Grain, CCD for the Y2K digicam look, direct Flash, projector Dust, a warm light Leak and a cross-screen Star. No post-processing, no waiting.

THREE CAMERAS, ONE VIBE

Switch between the Toy skin, the Instant skin — where every shot ejects and develops like a real instant print — and the Pro skin. Flash (real torch or screen pop), digital zoom, spirit level and a selfie flip.

PRO CAMERA

Manual ISO, shutter speed, focus, white balance and exposure compensation with a live readout, tap-to-focus, 4:3 / 1:1 / 16:9 / full aspect ratios, timer, grid and full-resolution stills. Drive modes for burst, exposure bracketing, an intervalometer for time lapse, a night mode, focus stacking and a dual-camera shot. Film LUTs with adjustable strength and a colour pad for temperature and tint — graded live on the viewfinder and baked into the photo.

Also: program, shutter-priority, ISO-priority and manual modes; a chip for each real lens (wide, ultra-wide, tele); focus peaking, zebra, false colour and scopes that never reach the photo; a focus loupe; volume keys as shutter; RAW (DNG) next to the JPEG, free; and recipes for up to twelve setups.

PHOTO EDITOR

Open any shot or a photo from your gallery: LUTs and presets, exposure, contrast, curves, white balance and more. Import your own .cube LUTs and Lightroom-style presets. Highlights, shadows, clarity, vignette and HSL for eight colours; hold to compare. Save an edit as a recipe, bake your colour work into a LUT, or export it as .cube or .xmp.

PHOTOBOOTH

On-device selfie segmentation cuts you out and drops you over six studio gradients — with your look and effects still applied on top.

VIDEO WITH THE LOOK BAKED IN

Hold the shutter for clips up to 15 seconds — LUT, rain and grain are encoded right into the file, with optional microphone.

FRAME IT

Polaroid, Booth, Cutie, Frame, Noir, Retro or Raw — add a caption, save to your gallery or share anywhere.

YOUR PIN-BOARD

Every shot lands on a cork board as a rotated, pinned polaroid. Drag them around, shuffle, switch to a list or a photo-album view, and save the whole board as a single image — arranged exactly as you pinned it. Choose one of six backgrounds, add photos and clips from your gallery, or print it. Deleted shots wait 30 days in Recently Deleted.

CLOUD BOARDS

Sign in with Google or email to open your shared boards from the web app, join a friend's board with a code, or view a public board — no account needed for that. Invite friends with a QR code or a link, or share a view-only link.

FREE, AND FILMODE PRO

No ads and no watermark, ever. The cameras, the effects, the editor, the photobooth, the board and 18 looks — Basic and Retro — are free, and so are the .cube LUTs and presets you import yourself. Filmode Pro adds 25 more looks (Cinematic, Film and Selfie) and the two frame-stacking drives, long exposure and light trails. Every Pro look previews live in the viewfinder first; only keeping the shot asks. Pro is monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime unlock.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

No account required. Your photos, clips and board stay on your device unless you choose to share them. Anonymous usage and crash reports never include photos or location; switch them off in the camera settings.

description:
Marwo protects your photos before they go online — and proves that they are real. The processing runs completely offline on your phone: no upload, no cloud, no account, no tracking, no ads.

✦ NEW: VISIBLE PROTECTION MARKS THAT SURVIVE EVERY UPLOAD

Instagram, Facebook & Co. strip the invisible metadata from your photo the moment you upload it — and with it every protection signal. That is why Marwo also puts visible symbol marks straight into the image:

🚫 Scraping — your visible stop sign against photo scrapers

✦ AI — the star symbol for AI-processed images, the way major tech platforms have established it for AI content

Together they appear as one discreet bar in the picture. What is written on the pixels, no platform can strip away.

🛡️ INVISIBLE PROTECTION INSIDE THE FILE

• Metadata gone: GPS location, camera model, capture date, serial number — the entire EXIF block is deleted.

• "No AI training" signal: into every processed image Marwo writes a machine-readable signal against text and data mining. It is always in there, whichever boxes you tick.

• AI labelling (optional): on request Marwo marks your image as "processed with AI" — following the provenance standard that image agencies use as well. Voluntary labelling, fit for the EU.

✅ PROOF OF AUTHENTICITY

Marwo embeds an invisible, hard-to-forge ownership stamp into your photo. With the built-in verifier you can show later that an image came from you — even if it was re-photographed or cropped. Including a proof PDF. Marwo only accepts genuine camera originals, no screenshots and no third-party images.

📁 YOUR PROOF SURVIVES A CHANGE OF PHONE

Marwo keeps a record for every photo you protect. You can save these records as a file and load them again on a new phone. If your device breaks or you buy a new one — your proof is still there.

🫥 ANONYMISE WITH ONE TAP

• Cover faces automatically (auto mode, Google ML Kit on the device)

• Licence plates, logos or other details: tap and pixelate them yourself

✨ AND EVERYTHING FOR YOUR LISTINGS — ONE APP INSTEAD OF FIVE

• Remove the background: white, studio grey, frosted glass, blur, spotlight

• Crop with zoom, made to fit every platform

• Colour boost, your own logo & name watermark (adjustable strength)

• One tap → every format for messengers, selling platforms (Kleinanzeigen, Vinted, eBay, mobile.de & Co.) and social media (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat)

• 17 languages and country profiles for more than 50 countries — each with the local selling platforms of your country

💎 PAY FAIRLY: BUY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION

The free version gives you the full protection for one photo per run. Marwo Premium (one-time purchase) unlocks batch processing with up to 5 photos and the "all formats at once" button. No subscription, no follow-up costs.

🔒 PRIVACY BY DESIGN

Your photos never leave the device — no image upload, no server of our own, no cloud, no tracking, no ads.

Note: face detection uses Google ML Kit and runs on the device. The invisible file signals work in the original; on platforms that remove metadata, the visible symbol marks stay.

description:
Halftone Photo Editor is a creative photo editing app designed to turn your pictures into bold halftone artwork inspired by printmaking, screen printing and retro graphic styles.

Create striking photo effects with customizable ink colors, halftone patterns, paper textures and frame options. Start with a ready-made look, generate a random style, or fine-tune each setting to build your own result.

🎨 HALFTONE PHOTO EFFECTS

Transform your photos with dots, lines, squares, diamonds and grain-based screen patterns.

Adjust the size, density and angle of the halftone effect to create anything from subtle printed texture to a stronger graphic look.

🖌️ CUSTOM INK COLORS

Work with one, two or three ink layers.

Choose from different colors, adjust ink intensity and add a slight ink offset to recreate the imperfect registration often found in printed artwork.

✨ READY-MADE LOOKS

Apply curated looks to quickly explore different combinations of colors, screens and print styles.

Use the Effect Strength control when you want a lighter result that keeps more of the original photo visible.

🎲 RANDOM STYLES

Generate new combinations of ink colors, halftone settings, paper textures and image adjustments with one tap.

Each random style creates a different starting point that you can continue editing manually.

📄 PAPER TEXTURES

Choose between several paper styles including white, warm, natural, gray, kraft and black.

Adjust paper grain and ink variation to add more texture and character to your artwork.

🖼️ FRAMES & FORMATS

Choose from multiple image ratios including Original, 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 9:16 and A4.

Customize margins, corner radius and rough edges to create poster, print and social media compositions.

🎚️ PHOTO ADJUSTMENTS

Fine-tune your image with controls for:

• Brightness

• Contrast

• Saturation

• Exposure

• Posterization

• Color inversion

🔍 PREVIEW YOUR DETAILS

Zoom and move around your image while editing to check halftone patterns and print details more closely.

description:
Connect your pictures with the places you visit. GeoStamp combines a GPS camera, a photo map, and a photo collage editor for travel memories, site visits, and everyday visual records.

Capture photos with available GPS

When location is available on your device, GeoStamp saves it with pictures you take in the app. Open a saved image to review its place, add a note, or mark a favorite. Photo details show the saved GPS accuracy reading when available. Note an observation, a place name, or a detail you want to remember. You can also select a point on the map yourself and change it later.

Explore your pictures on a map

See the images you have added to GeoStamp at their saved locations. Open them from map pins or browse the in-app gallery, grouped by date. The map's Today and This Week filters cover today and the past seven days. Keep favorites handy when you are ready to build a collage.

Import one image at a time

Choose an existing photo from your phone's gallery and assign a place manually. Imported images use the date and time they were added to GeoStamp. The app does not import their original capture date or GPS location. You can then include the image in a collage with the details you selected.

Make photo collages with maps

Start with the photo and map layout to use one picture as the background and arrange the rest as separate cards. You can also choose a split layout with pictures beside each other or stacked, a grid, a magazine design, or a postcard. Include a mini map as part of the composition.

Display date, time, and place

Add location and date stamps in the collage editor. Display the saved date and time, include an address when available, and choose whether coordinates should appear. Show or hide the map and caption to fit the image you want to share.

Make the design your own

Add multiple text boxes for a title, a place name, or a brief description. Give each box its own text and style. Adjust text size, colors, backgrounds, and borders, then move, resize, and rotate photo cards, the map, and text elements.

Choose a square, portrait, or landscape format. Use a picture or a solid color as the background, and preview the finished layout before exporting. Arrange your images and text so the details that matter are easy to see.

Save as PNG and share

Export the finished collage as a PNG image. Use compatible apps on your phone to share the saved result. Send a map collage to a friend, collect memories from a trip, or keep a visual record of a site visit with the information you selected.

For travel and everyday records

Keep a viewpoint, a property, or a work visit connected to its pictures. Notes explain what you observed, and a collage brings the scene and its place together in one image.

GPS availability and accuracy depend on your device, permissions, and surroundings. Review the saved position before sharing, especially when you have chosen or changed it manually.

Bothie is a dual camera app for Android that combines your front and back camera views in one photo or video. Capture the scene and the person behind the camera, from travel selfies to family moments and reaction videos.

Simultaneous capture depends on your phone. On supported devices, both cameras capture at the same time. When that is unavailable, Bothie guides you through rear-then-front capture and combines the two views. Sequential capture does not record the same instant.

Picture-in-picture camera

Keep the scene as the main view and include yourself in a smaller selfie window. Move the PiP window to suit the composition. Core picture-in-picture photo and video capture is free.

More layouts with Bothie Creator

The optional one-time Creator purchase unlocks side-by-side and top-and-bottom split-screen layouts on Android. Give both perspectives space, whether you are recording a conversation or photographing a family milestone.

Shoot now. Reframe a photo later.

Creator also lets you reshape eligible recent dual-camera photos after capture:

- Swap the front and rear views

- Move or resize the picture-in-picture window

- Change the photo layout, frame shape and border style

- Choose an export ratio: 3:4, 9:16, 16:9, 4:5 or 1:1

- Export one selected composition at a time

Photo reframing requires the original capture data to remain available. It is not a general photo importer or a video editor.

A camera for your everyday stories

Take a selfie with scenery. Keep the photographer in a group memory. Record a performance and your reaction, or make a travel vlog with front and rear perspectives. Bothie saves the composed photo or video to your device's gallery.

Your media stays on your device

Photos and videos are processed locally and are not uploaded by Bothie. No account is required, and there are no ads or social feed. Optional Android usage analytics are controlled by your consent in Privacy settings.

Bothie is for camera capture, not screen recording or live streaming. Camera support varies by device.

description:
Edit, retouch and decorate photos and make collages in one photo editor: background removal, object removal, filters, text, stickers, mosaic and blur. Editing happens on your device, and no account is needed.

MAIN FEATURES

■ Remove background

Removes the background around people and objects in one tap. Refine it with brushes, color or lasso. Keep it transparent (PNG) or replace it with a color, gradient, blur or another photo. Add a shadow or outline, or turn the cutout into a sticker.

■ Remove unwanted objects

Brush over people, power lines or litter, and they're filled in with the surrounding pattern. Remove several strokes at once, or each spot as soon as you lift your finger.

■ Filters

70+ filters with adjustable strength. Save a filter and adjustments as "My preset" and reuse the look in one tap. Import 3D LUT (.cube) files too.

■ Adjust, auto fix, curves & HSL

19 settings with a histogram, from exposure and shadows to clarity, dehaze, noise reduction and grain. Auto fix corrects brightness, levels and color casts at once. Tone curves (RGB, R, G, B) and HSL for 8 colors give precise control, and local adjustments apply only where you paint.

■ Text

40+ built-in fonts, device fonts and your own font files. Color, gradient, texture, outline, shadow, neon glow, background, spacing and opacity. Vertical text and text on a curve, with as many layers as you like.

■ Stickers

500+ stickers in 15 categories, plus emoji, shapes, arrows and speech bubbles. Save cutouts as your own stickers or layer another photo.

■ Collage

Combine 2 to 9 photos with straight or diagonal layouts, or arrange them freely. Choose the ratio, spacing, corners, shadows and a color, gradient or blurred background. Swap, replace, flip and rotate photos, then keep editing in the editor.

■ Blur & mosaic

Portrait-style background blur, plus circle, tilt-shift, full and brush blur. Hide details with mosaic, blur, frosted glass, solid fill or patterns, and find and hide faces automatically before sharing.

■ Skin retouch

Smooths skin on detected faces, adjusts brightness and tone, removes blemishes with a tap, and reshapes contours.

■ Effects & overlays

20+ effects such as HDR look, glitch, VHS, sketch, comic, oil paint, halftone, pixel art and duotone. Add light leaks, bokeh or a double exposure with 12 blend modes. Color splash keeps only part of the color.

■ Neon, wings, drip and more

Glowing neon and wings around a person, dripping paint, art, motion, PixLab, SQ/BG shapes and 2D/3D mirror.

■ Frames, ratio & crop

Border, instant-photo, film and card frames with colors, 65 gradients or blur. Fit a photo into a social-media ratio without cutting it. Crop with 22 ratios, rotate, flip, straighten and fix perspective.

■ Brush

Pen, marker, highlighter, neon, airbrush, magic pattern brushes, lines, arrows and shapes.

■ Batch edit

Apply the same filter, adjustments or preset to up to 50 photos and save them all at once.

EASY TO USE

• Unlimited undo and redo; press and hold to compare, pinch to zoom

• Drafts are saved automatically so you can continue later

• Open photos from "Share" or "Edit" in other apps, or from the camera

• Light and dark themes; landscape and tablet layouts

• My works lists your saved images, ready to edit again

SAVING

• Your original is never overwritten; new files go to Pictures/PhotoEditorPro

• JPEG, PNG (transparent) or WebP, with quality and size

• Up to 12.6 MP by default, or 24 MP in settings

• Exif can be kept; location is removed by default

• No watermark

PRICE

Try every feature free for 2 days after installing. When the trial ends, the app is locked; a one-time in-app purchase unlocks it so you can keep using every feature. It is not a subscription.

PRIVACY

Editing, cutout and face detection run on your device; photos are never sent to a server. The Android photo picker is used, so the app doesn't ask for access to all your photos.
